summary: Trust record per design: requirement margins, GCI error bars from three mesh levels, equilibrium, energy and hand-calc checks, plain-language assumptions, a rule-based confidence grade and a reproducible evidence bundle.

tasks.task: Build the trust record for a design.
steps: 1. trust(design, spec) runs the checks on the fine-mesh result, a two-level mesh-convergence check on peak stress and max displacement, and the reaction equilibrium error.
2. Record solver and version, units, mesh reports, assumptions from the spec and the validation-suite status (last pytest -m validation result with date).
3. Mark status verified only when every check ran and passed; otherwise not_verified with reasons.
4. Write trust.json beside the design bundle.
tasks.done_when: Every delivered design has a trust.json with all checks run.
do_not: do not mark verified when any check is missing
tasks.stop_and_ask_if: mesh convergence on peak stress exceeds 10% between levels for the chosen design.

tasks.task: Add GCI error bars, energy and hand-calculation checks, the confidence grade and the reproducible evidence bundle.
tasks.where: engine/src/trust.cpp, new files engine/src/gci.cpp, engine/src/handcalc.cpp, scripts/reproduce.py
steps: 1. gci.estimate(values, sizes) computes the Grid Convergence Index from three mesh levels for each governing value.
2. A requirement whose margin is smaller than its GCI error is reported as not_proven, not passed.
3. Check strain energy against the external work of applied loads within 1%.
4. handcalc.py gives the beam-theory estimate for the governing section of each family; flag the design when FEA and the estimate differ by more than a factor of 2.
5. Grade A when every check ran and passed, GCI below 5% on governing values and the validation suite passed; B when GCI is up to 10%; otherwise C. Write the rule into trust.json.
6. scripts/reproduce.py <design dir> re-runs the evidence bundle and asserts the reported numbers match within 0.1%.
tasks.done_when: Every delivered design has error bars, independent checks, a grade with its rule and reproduces from its bundle.
do_not: do not let any agent tool write to trust.json
tasks.stop_and_ask_if: GCI cannot be computed because the three levels do not converge monotonically for the demo design.

acceptance: trust.json present for every delivered design
No design shows verified with a missing check
Margins smaller than the error are shown as not proven
risks: Peak stress at re-entrant corners does not converge; the record uses stress at a defined distance from fillets and says so.
